sources.note: SAMO (not Kubo): sec. 2.3.2.2 p.112 'Stress is contrastive, falling on either the first or second syllable and other syllables following in words of three syllables or more. Primary stress is on the first stressed syllable of the word and secondary stress occurs on alternate following syllables.' plus 2.3.2.3 stress perturbation under affixation (alternating pattern, no contiguous unstressed syllables).
